intro.speaker: {actor}
intro.text: Welcome to this week's society talk! Today: getting started with open-source projects as a student.

body.speaker: {actor}
body.text: Start small: fix documentation, read the open issues, ask questions. Any questions from the audience?

options.text: How do I find a first issue?

answer.speaker: {actor}
answer.text: Look for issues labelled for newcomers, and don't be shy to ask the maintainers. Thank you all for coming!
